text: 1) Non-Chinese citizens who are in good health, hold a valid foreign passport, obtained a high school diploma or equivalent, and are willing to comply with Chinese laws and regulations of CSU. Applicants must comply with the regulations (JW[2020] NO.12) issued by the Ministry of Education of PRC.2) Aged between 18-25 (born before May 30, 2005). Applicants who are under the age of 18 (above 16) need an eligible guardian living in China.3) Language requirements: students who apply for majors in science and engineering should obtain a minimum score of 260 in HSK4; for medical and other majors of arts, a minimum score of 200 in HSK5. Students who cannot meet the requirement of Chinese language proficiency shall take a one-year preparatory Chinese language course and meet relevant Chinese language standards before embarking on degree programs. Applicants whose previous degree education was Chinese-taught are exempt from proving language proficiency.
